name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: I'm applying for the Manager, Client Partnership role. DEPT sitting 50/50 between tech and marketing is exactly where I do my best work. I've spent 15 years as the client-side partner who keeps accounts healthy and growing, and the last two building AI-driven marketing systems, so I read both the relationship and the machinery underneath it.

What I'd bring to your media accounts: agency client service across paid media, inbound, and content (Level Agency, Fetch & Funnel), where I owned reporting, QBRs, and the day-to-day relationship. A real track record on retention and growth, I managed a reseller portfolio at Birdeye and kept all but one account (about 94%), and drove measurable traffic and conversion lift across an account book at Wix. Hands-on campaign work, including optimizing paid search accounts and managing budgets and scope as a team lead. And a habit of finding the next opportunity inside an account, expanding retainer scope where it genuinely fit the client's goals.

Where I'd add the most, fast, is the tech side of client partnership, building the reporting, automation, and systems that make a media team quicker and catch issues (pacing, tracking, discrepancies) before they reach the client. For a company built on growth invention, that mix of client ownership and systems thinking is what I'd bring. I'd welcome the conversation.
Thank you for your time and consideration.
